A little about my work

From data to dependable systems.

I bring a data-informed perspective to building the systems people rely on.

After beginning my career in machine learning and data analysis, I moved into Java backend development to focus on the foundations behind useful products. I build REST APIs and role-based access control with Spring Boot, Spring Security, and Hibernate—organized into clean controller, service, and repository layers. My approach is deliberate: clear structure, secure behavior, and software that is easier to maintain.
